import enum

class Status(enum.Enum):
    OK = 0
    FAILED = 1

from enum import IntEnum

class Priority(IntEnum):
    LOW = 1
    HIGH = 2

from typing import NamedTuple

class Pair(NamedTuple):
    left: int
    right: int
